method: Actual Lion Runtime timeout of std::future::pending, measured with std::time::Instant; compiled against the same release Lion rlib as the client
cause: Lion floors both its Instant clock and std::time::Duration conversions to milliseconds
client_change: Pad send timer by two milliseconds; classify cancellation by whether the measurement deadline or operation timeout bounded the send; retain and log genuine send errors
scope: Demonstrates a real early-expiration mechanism. The aborted matrix's discarded send-error detail is unavailable, so this probe does not prove that its sole error was a false positive.
